study type: Cost-effectiveness analysis using a decision-analysis model
exposure: Twin vaginal deliveries (VDs) in the labor and delivery room (LDR)
Twin vaginal deliveries (VDs) in the operating room (OR)
outcome: Probability of neonatal morbidity after emergent CD
Probability of neonatal death from emergent CD
Conversion to cesarean delivery (CD) for twin B
cohort: The study analyzed twin gestations undergoing a trial of labor.
finding: Performing twin vaginal deliveries in the labor and delivery room (LDR) was found to be the most cost-effective strategy in the base-case scenario.
mod_finding: The cost-effectiveness of delivering in the OR increased when the probability of successful vaginal delivery was less than 86% or if the probability of neonatal morbidity/death after emergent cesarean delivery exceeded specific thresholds.
gest_age: Gestational age was taken into account
